name: How long does sliding window installation typically take?
description: Installation time varies by the number and size of windows, but typically ranges from a few hours for one to several days for a full house.

mainEntity.name: How long does sliding window installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for sliding windows varies based on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the existing opening. A single window might take a few hours, while a full house replacement could span several days. To help us provide an accurate estimate, customers should consider measuring the existing window openings or having a preliminary consultation so we can assess the scope of work and potential structural considerations.
